I.E. CPBG SHALL REMAIN VAL ID UP TO THREE MONTHS BEYOND THE GUARANTEE/WARRANTY PERIOD. THE CPBG SHALL BE SUBMITTE D WITHIN 21 DAYS FROM THE DATE OF GEM CONTRACT. 3.2 CPBG shall also be accepted in the following forms: (i) The CONTRACT-CUM-PERFORMANCE BANK GUARANTEE (CPBG) can be submitted in the form of Electr onic Bank Guarantee i.e. e-CPBG ONLY IN NALCO'S PRESCRIBED CPBG FORMAT (ANNEXURE-IX attach ed as Buyer uploaded ATC documents ) FROM ANY BANK APPROVED BY NALCO ( ANNEXURE-X attached as Buyer uploaded ATC documents) . Note- For submission of e-CPBG through NeSL platform, details of NALCO (beneficiary) shall be as mentioned in the attached Annexure-XI. (ii) In the form of online transfer - NEFT, RTGS (iii) Account payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt, etc. from a Commercial Bank. The Proof of such transfer / transaction must be submitted However, CPBG will NOT be accepted in cash. 3.3 THE CPBG SHALL BE SUBMITTED WITHIN 21DAYS FROM THE DATE OF GEM CONTRACT AT FOLLOWIN G ADDRESS: Mr. Shri Sitendu Kumar Maharana, Astt. General Manager(Finance) , Finance Deptt., National Aluminiu m Company Limited, Smelter Plant, Angul – 759145, Odisha. e-mail: Sitendu.Maharana @nalcoindia. co.in 3.4 IF SUPPLIER FAILS TO SUBMIT CPBG AFTER PLACEMENT OF GEM CONTRACT, THE EQUIVALENT AMOU NT SHALL BE RECOVERED FROM THE BILL(S) OF THE SUPPLIER/CONTRACTOR TILL THE FULL AMOUNT IS RECOVERED. SUBJECT TO ANY DEDUCTION WHICH NALCO IS AUTHORIZED TO MAKE, CPBG SHALL BE RELEASED AFTER SATISFACTORY EXECUTION OF THE CONTRACT. ON THE BREACH OF THE CONTRACT BY THE SUPPLIER, C PBG SHALL BE FORFEITED/ENCASHED WHETHER OR NOT THE COMPANY HAS SUFFERED A LOSS ON THIS ACCOUNT AND CONTRACT SHALL BE RESCINDED. FORFEITURE/ENCASHMENT OF CPBG DOES NOT PREJU DICE NALCO'S RIGHTS TO MAKE RISK PURCHASES AND RECOVER DAMAGES ON ACCOUNT OF SUCH RISK PURCHASES. NOTE- CPBG/e-CPBG MUST be submitted as per NALCO'S CPBG FORMAT ONLY . NALCO’S CP BG format Supersedes GEM CPBG format. 4. 5.1 DELIVERY PERIOD: WITHIN 180 DAYS FROM THE DATE OF PO PLACEMENT. 6. NALCO WILL DO THE INSTALLATION & COMMISSIONING OF THE FAN ASSEMBLY . NON-SUBMISSION OF THE SAME S HALL LEAD TO TECHNICAL REJCTION OF THE OFFER. 8. PRICE : a) THE PRICE MUST BE QUOTED ON ‘F.O.R. , NALCO SMELTER PLANT CENTRAL STORE’ BASIS (i .e. THEREFORE, PLEASE DO NOT MENTION ANY DEVIATION TO THI S GEM BID TERMS AND CONDITIONS IN YOUR OFFER. 11. INCOME TAX / BILLING CLAUSES: i. UNDER INCOME TAX CLAUSES (A) FOR SUPPLY CONTRACTS / PURCHASE ORDERS / SUPPLY PORTION OF LSTK NALCO, BEING BUYER (U NDER SECTION 194Q INSERTED IN THE INCOME TAX ACT, 1961 VIDE FINANCE ACT 2021) HAVING TOTAL SALES. VENDORS/SELLERS ARE NOT TO COLLECT TAX AT S OURCE UNDER SECTION 206C(1H) OF THE ACT W.E.F. 01.07.2021, IN CASE PROVISIONS OF SECTION AR E APPLICABLE TO THEM. THE ABOVE IS AS PER THE CURRENT STATUE AND IS SUBJECT TO MODIFICATION(S) BASED ON AMENDMENTS/NOTIFICATIONS UNDER INCOME TAX ACT, 1961, FROM TIME TO TIME. (B) FOR OTHER CONTRACTS / ORDERS INCOME TAX TDS, AS APPLICABLE AT THE PREVAILING RATE ON THE GROSS AMOUNT BILLED SHALL BE DEDUCTED FROM THE CONTRACTOR’S BILLS. ii. UNDER INCOME TAX / BILLING CLAUSES VENDOR / PARTY CATEGORISED/DESIGNATED AS “SPECIFIED P ERSON” UNDER SECTION 206AB OF INCOME TAX ACT, 1961 SHALL BE LIABLE FOR TDS AT HIGHER RATE AS PROVIDED UNDER THE SAID SECTION, BY NALCO.
